Class BuildingEffect

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.cards.building.BuildingEffect
public final class BuildingEffect extends Object
Describes the effects of a building card. A building may have at most one hook per category: - eventTrigger + eventHook: fires during a specific EventType - turnHook: fires when the player repositions their totem - acquisitionHook: fires when the player acquires a character - endGameScorer: contributes to the final score - hasPostRound: enables the extra post-round action (Watchtower) - shamanicModifier: capability for the Shamanic Ritual event - sustenanceModifier: capability for the Sustenance event
